# Code review: `SegmentedControl` (mobile)

**Mode:** full review of `e7d8ae856...HEAD`, committed work only. Everything was read-only: I didn't install anything, run tests or use `gh`.

- **Scope:** 3 files, +84 −0. Base `e7d8ae8` → HEAD `d52cb04` (one commit: *feat(mobile): add reusable SegmentedControl primitive*). The two untracked folders in the worktree weren't part of the range and weren't reviewed.
- **Repo:** Safe{Wallet} monorepo, mobile app (Expo, Tamagui, jest with React Native Testing Library). It has 3 written rules that apply to this change: `apps/mobile/AGENTS.md` (use tokens), `apps/mobile/docs/code-style.md` (folder layout) and the root `AGENTS.md` (testing). 8 of 9 review areas apply; security doesn't.
- **Checking:** each finding was checked by one agent trying to prove it and another trying to disprove it. 4 of 4 checked · 2 held · 2 held but weaker than first stated · 0 disproved.

## Summary

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | **Ready to open the PR.** Nothing blocks it. |
| **Score** | **92 / 100** (4 of 4 findings checked) |
| **What cost points** | Four small issues, all P3: a missing test, an accessibility role, hard-coded values and a missing story |
| **Fix first** | The testID test (F4) and the accessibility role (F3). Each is a few lines. |

## Scores by area

| Area | Score | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Conventions | 88 | F1, F2 |
| Testing | 90 | F4 |
| Bugs / accessibility | 94 | F3 |
| Regression | 100 | New files only; nothing existing is touched |
| Architecture | 100 | Right place (`src/components/`), named exports, `index.ts` barrel |
| Performance | 100 | Maps over a short, fixed list of options |
| DRY | 100 | Checked `SafeTab/SafeTabBar.tsx`: it's a collapsible tab-view bar, not reusable as a toggle, so this isn't a duplicate |
| KISS | 100 | Small and typed with generics; nothing speculative |
| Security | n/a | Presentation-only UI component with no data, input handling or network access |

## Not covered by this review

- No tests or type-check were run (read-only request). Nothing here has been checked against a real screen reader.
- The component has **no consumers yet**. The commit says the upcoming ScanConnect sheet will use it, so that integration wasn't reviewed.

## Findings (all P3, worth fixing now or ticketing)

| ID | Area | Location | Finding | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F4 | Testing | `apps/mobile/src/components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.tsx:30` (and `:19`) | The `testID` handling isn't tested: the container `testID` and the per-segment `` `${testID}-${option.value}` `` both lack coverage. None of the three tests passes a `testID` or uses `getByTestId`, so breaking that line fails nothing. E2E selectors will rely on these IDs. **Fix:** add a test that renders with `testID="tabs"` and checks `getByTestId('tabs-mycode')`. | Held (both agents) |
| F3 | Bugs (accessibility) | `apps/mobile/src/components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.tsx:26-27`, container at `:19` | Each segment uses `accessibilityRole="button"` with `selected`, and the container has no role. VoiceOver and TalkBack will read the segments as separate buttons, not as one either/or group with position ("2 of 2"). **Fix:** use `accessibilityRole="tab"` on the segments and `accessibilityRole="tablist"` on the `XStack`, or `radio`/`radiogroup`. | Held, weaker: no user sees it until the first consumer ships. It ships with that consumer unless fixed here. |
| F1 | Conventions | `apps/mobile/src/components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.tsx:19` (`borderRadius={12}`), `:37` (`borderRadius={8}`) | Hard-coded radii where tokens with the same values exist (`$5` = 12, `$4` = 8, from `packages/theme/src/tokens/radius.ts`, set up in `apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts:31-33`). This breaks `apps/mobile/AGENTS.md:20`: "Use Tamagui tokens, not hard-coded values". The rest of the file already uses tokens. **Fix:** `borderRadius="$5"` / `"$4"`. | Held, weaker: roughly 25% of existing `borderRadius` uses in the mobile app are numbers too (e.g. `AnalysisDetails.tsx:32`) |
| F2 | Conventions | `apps/mobile/src/components/SegmentedControl/` (no `SegmentedControl.stories.tsx`) | `apps/mobile/docs/code-style.md:9-18` shows the component folder as `*.tsx` / `*.test.tsx` / `*.stories.tsx` / `index`, and mobile Storybook is set up (`apps/mobile/.storybook/`). This new shared primitive has no story. | Held, weaker: the doc gives it as an example, not a rule, and most components don't have one either (the two agents counted 16 and 32 of 73 folders with a story) |

## Your call

| ID | Options |
|---|---|
| F4, F3 | Fix before opening the PR (recommended, a few lines each) |
| F1 | Fix now (a two-token change) or skip |
| F2 | Add a story or ticket it; not required |

## Worth tidying

Nothing to propose. All three files are new, so there's no older code nearby to clean up.

## Not sure / ruled out

- **Not filed:** pressing the segment that's already selected still calls `onChange`. That's a reasonable design choice, but no test pins it down either way.
- **Ruled out:** duplicate React keys (option values are typed string values, and callers supply unique ones). The test wrapper `@/src/tests/test-utils` renders with the theme provider, so the `$token` colours resolve in tests.
